segments.title: Cold Open & Station Sign-On
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the official top-of-hour sign-on as a dog, counting down to live broadcast.

segments.title: Opening Desk Banter
segments.notes: Case and Pepito discuss hair, milk, Pepito's mother, tiny computers, the Wall project paperwork for Friday, and a chat debate about zombie civil rights.

segments.title: Charlie Kirk Assassination Coverage
segments.notes: Case and Rick discuss the Nepal Discord government story briefly, then pivot to the Charlie Kirk shooting: suspect details, trans roommate discourse, FBI confusion, and conservative cancel-culture retaliation.

segments.title: Cash Patel FBI Statement
segments.notes: Case and Rick watch FBI Director Cash Patel's Fox & Friends victory lap on the Kirk arrest, mocking his delivery, transparency claims, and the 'Valhalla' sign-off to Charlie Kirk.

segments.title: Internet Discourse Rant
segments.notes: Case delivers an extended monologue on the stupidity amplification machine of Twitter, Ryan Grim's 'both sides' cancel-culture take, and the broader rot of online conversation.

segments.title: Kendall Phone Call
segments.notes: Kendall calls in to arrange a 4 AM airport ride; Case announces a shorter stream to spend time with her before her work trip.

segments.title: Movie Trailers
segments.notes: Case and Rick watch trailers for 'Nightmares of Nature' (Conjuring producers), 'Argonaut' (1960s Superman knockoff with 'kill each other' mind-control), 'The Witcher' Season 4 (Liam Hemsworth), and skip the Ed Gein trailer.

segments.title: Zombie Civil Rights Debate
segments.notes: Munch and Crum debate from hell/crawlspace: Munch denies zombies civil rights; Crum argues for ethical brain-eating. Munch declares the mechanical gorilla gone and the Crum Dick Punch mission accomplished.

segments.title: Hype Train Subscriber Shoutouts
segments.notes: Hype Train appears outside the window, delivers Garfield-type beat rap for subs (Bruiser St. George 12 months, Card King, etc.), claims curing-cancer kisses for his panther girlfriend.

segments.title: Jeff Ripple News Block
segments.notes: Jeff reads: scuba-gear Disney Springs robbery, Nigerian church penis-regrowth miracle, Trump's second Venezuela narco-terrorist strike, UK Ferrari F1-livery GP2 car on motorway, NASA Perseverance Mars biosignature study.

segments.title: Mars Biosignature Science Desk
segments.notes: Chet interrupts for the Mars story: Perseverance found vivianite and griguite in Sapphire Canyon mudstone, potential microbial biosignatures; Chet riffs on Dune worms and 'skientific' shorthand.

segments.title: Final News Rundown
segments.notes: Jeff reads: Ricky Hatton death, Ice Cube War of the Worlds 15-day isolated shoot, 29-minute breath-hold record (pure O2 pre-breathe), San Francisco Narcan vigilante misuse, HBO Max price hike/Zaslav at Goldman Sachs Communicopia, Fox News Brian Kilmeade 'involuntary lethal injection' comment for homeless.

segments.title: Belly Dancing & Life Skills
segments.notes: Jeb (reconstructed jaw, dad's spirit in wood) attempts belly dance tutorials (shimmy, hip lift, Egyptian, hip drop), watches Gun Mario hot dog eating, slap tutorial, Mike Tyson pushups; ends with Drano stomach-noises bit.

segments.title: Sign-Off
segments.notes: Case and Pepito close out; Pepito plays his song, reminds of Wednesday return, exits as a dog.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell anchored a Monday broadcast dominated by the Charlie Kirk assassination aftermath, featuring a Cash Patel FBI victory lap, a Discord denial, and a sprawling rant on internet discourse rot. The desk devolved into a Munch & Crum zombie-rights debate from hell where Munch declared the mechanical gorilla gone and the Crum Dick Punch resolved. Hype Train delivered a Garfield-beat sub rap, Jeff Ripple ran a news gauntlet from Disney Springs scuba heists to Mars biosignatures, Chet interrupted for the Perseverance findings, and Jeb Nogget closed the show with a reconstructed-jaw belly-dancing tutorial, Gun Mario hot-dog eating, and a Drano stomach-noises finale.
